blocks.x: Forwarders and 3PLs sell reliability and information: quotes, visibility, exception handling and compliance evidence across multi-modal networks. Agentic orchestration and event-driven visibility convert operational chaos into a control-tower product customers pay for.

The workflows we industrialize here: Quoting and booking, Shipment visibility, Exception management, Customs documentation, Carrier settlement. Each arrives with its current cycle times measured in the Diagnose phase, and each leaves the program governed by outcome SLOs rather than anecdotes.

items: Carrier portals/EDI patchwork; ETAs updated by phone.
Rate lookups and exception queues eat ops capacity; margin leaks in rework.
Carrier identity fraud and double-brokering; verification thin.
Documentation assembled per shipment; delays at borders.
Seasonal surges overwhelm planning; service fails at the money moments.
High-value/regulated goods custody undocumented; disputes costly.
